federated.subtitle: Collaborative machine learning for state-wide resource forecasting. Participating nodes contribute model updates while raw health data remains local.

agg.riskDesc: Aggregate regression models confirm an escalating slope mismatch. Namakkal region is identified as the outbreak epicentre (Severe deficit slope ≥ 11.5). Salem & Erode are verified as stable surplus buffers.

privacy.title: Privacy-First Aggregation
privacy.desc: Each district trains locally on its own data. Only model insights — not raw patient or stock data — are shared with the central aggregator, preserving privacy while improving predictions for everyone.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Salem, Erode, and Namakkal run independent linear regressions locally inside their nodes using their specific PHC inventories.
howItWorks.step2Desc: The district nodes transmit only computed trend coefficients (slope slopes, intercept weights) to the central aggregator.
howItWorks.step3Desc: The central node performs federated aggregation, calculating a unified state-wide resource allocation projection.

policy.title: Federated Scope & Policy
policy.desc: The same state-level federated aggregation pattern extends to a BRICS-level aggregator, allowing nations to share predictive intelligence for pandemic/outbreak preparedness without exposing raw health data across borders.
policy.rule1: 1. Local patient records never leave national borders.
policy.rule2: 2. Aggregated trend slopes are merged via secure multi-party computation (SMPC).
policy.rule3: 3. Dynamic forecasting updates occur under official health ministries.
